title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Upgrade Prices, Upgrade Allowance and Overdue Thresholds
content:
Four product settings bear on buying more free time within the Demurrage and Detention Free Time range:

- **Sold as an upgrade** — yes if a running record can switch to this product from a lower one by purchase, no otherwise.
- **List price** — what the product costs for a single container record, in US dollars.
- **Upgrades still available** — the further upgrades a record can buy during the time this product sits on it.
- **Overdue threshold** — a US dollar ceiling on the customer's overdue demurrage and detention balance; over it, this product is not available as an upgrade.

| Product | Sold as an upgrade | List price per container record | Upgrades still available while carried | Overdue threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | no | 0.00 | 1 | 1500.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | yes | 95.00 | 1 | 1500.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | yes | 195.00 | 1 | 2500.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | yes | 245.00 | 1 | 5000.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | yes | 395.00 | 1 | 5000.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | no | 0.00 | 0 | 15000.00 |

## Reading the settings

- The upgrade allowance is read from the product a record currently carries, whereas the overdue threshold is read from the product being bought.
- The two products shown as not sold, the tariff product and the contract product, carry a list price of 0.00.

**Q: Which threshold applies when a customer wants AHL Free Time Extension 7?**
The 2500.00 threshold of AHL Free Time Extension 7, the product being bought.

**Q: How many further upgrades can a record carrying AHL Contract Free Time 30 take?**
None; its allowance is 0.
